+# ===========================================================================
+# SELF-HOSTING — porting the REAL Rian lexer to Rian (slice 1)
+# ===========================================================================
+# The toy lexer (selfhost_lexer.rian) tokenized arithmetic only. This grows the
+# Rian-written lexer toward the *real* `Rian.Lexer` token vocabulary, one slice
+# at a time, checked for agreement against the reference by `Rian.Fixpoint`.
+#
+# Slice 1 adds **identifiers and keywords** on top of numbers/operators/parens —
+# newly writable because `Char` is now a real ordinal type (ADR-0036): the
+# scanner classifies bytes with `Char` comparisons (`c >= 'a' and c <= 'z'`) and
+# folds digit runs with ordinal arithmetic (`acc * 10 + c - '0'`). Keyword vs
+# identifier is decided by string-literal clause heads on the accumulated name.
+#
+# Char-class tests are *inlined* in `when` guards (BEAM guards cannot call a
+# user function), and the name is built by accumulating `Char`s and
+# `__prim_str_from_chars`-ing them (ADR-0047 §2 portable prelude).
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+mod SelfhostLexerV2 do
+  # The lexer's own token stream — projected onto `Rian.Lexer`'s tokens by the
+  # fixpoint harness (TNum -> {:num}, TId -> {:id}, TKw -> {:kw}, …).
+  type Tok := TNum(Int64) | TPlus | TMinus | TStar | TSlash | TLP | TRP | TId(String) | TKw(String)
+
+  pub def tokenize(src String) Vec(Tok) := lex(__prim_str_chars(src))
+
+  def lex(cs Vec(Char)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex([]) := []
+  def lex([c | rest]) when c == ' ' := lex(rest)
+  def lex(['+' | rest]) := [TPlus | lex(rest)]
+  def lex(['-' | rest]) := [TMinus | lex(rest)]
+  def lex(['*' | rest]) := [TStar | lex(rest)]
+  def lex(['/' | rest]) := [TSlash | lex(rest)]
+  def lex(['(' | rest]) := [TLP | lex(rest)]
+  def lex([')' | rest]) := [TRP | lex(rest)]
+  def lex([c | rest]) when c >= '0' and c <= '9' := lex_num([c | rest], 0)
+  def lex([c | rest]) when (c >= 'a' and c <= 'z') or (c >= 'A' and c <= 'Z') or c == '_' := lex_id([c | rest], [])
+  def lex([_ | rest]) := lex(rest)
+
+  # a run of digits -> one TNum (ordinal arithmetic: `c - '0' : Int64`)
+  def lex_num(cs Vec(Char), acc Int64) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_num([c | rest], acc) when c >= '0' and c <= '9' := lex_num(rest, acc * 10 + c - '0')
+  def lex_num(cs, acc) := [TNum(acc) | lex(cs)]
+
+  # a run of identifier chars -> the name string, classified as keyword or id.
+  # `chars` accumulates in reverse, then `rev` + `__prim_str_from_chars` rebuild
+  # the name in source order (portable: no host FFI).
+  def lex_id(cs Vec(Char), chars Vec(Char)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_id([c | rest], chars) when (c >= 'a' and c <= 'z') or (c >= 'A' and c <= 'Z') or (c >= '0' and c <= '9') or c == '_' := lex_id(rest, [c | chars])
+  def lex_id(cs, chars) := [classify(__prim_str_from_chars(rev(chars, []))) | lex(cs)]
+
+  # keyword set (a slice of `Rian.Lexer`'s @keywords) vs a plain identifier
+  def classify(name String) Tok
+  def classify("if") := TKw("if")
+  def classify("do") := TKw("do")
+  def classify("else") := TKw("else")
+  def classify("end") := TKw("end")
+  def classify("def") := TKw("def")
+  def classify(name) := TId(name)
+
+  # reverse a Char list onto an accumulator (pure Rian, cons recursion)
+  def rev(xs Vec(Char), acc Vec(Char)) Vec(Char)
+  def rev([], acc) := acc
+  def rev([x | xs], acc) := rev(xs, [x | acc])
+end

@@ -54,4 +54,43 @@ defmodule Rian.FixpointTest do
       assert {:op, "-"} in got
     end
   end
+
+  # ── lexer port, slice 1: identifiers + keywords (selfhost_lexer_v2.rian) ──
+  # v2 keeps its own `Tok` sum; its parens are `TLP`/`TRP` (`:tlp`/`:trp`), distinct
+  # from the toy lexer's `:tl_paren`/`:tr_paren`, so project them here.
+  defp project_v2({:t_id, s}), do: {:id, s}
+  defp project_v2({:t_kw, s}), do: {:kw, s}
+  defp project_v2(:tlp), do: {:lparen}
+  defp project_v2(:trp), do: {:rparen}
+  defp project_v2(other), do: project(other)
+
+  # within slice-1's vocabulary: integers, identifiers, the five keywords v2
+  # classifies, the four operators, parens, and spaces
+  @corpus_v2 [
+    "foo",
+    "x_1",
+    "if x do y end",
+    "12 * (x_1 + foo)",
+    "a + b - c",
+    "def f",
+    "x1 * y2 / z3",
+    "  spaced  out  ",
+    "ifx else end"
+  ]
+
+  describe "lexer port slice 1 — identifiers + keywords agree with the reference" do
+    setup do
+      mod =
+        Fixpoint.load_lexer(
+          File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_lexer_v2.rian"),
+          :rian_fixpoint_lexer_v2
+        )
+
+      {:ok, mod: mod}
+    end
+
+    test "the v2 Rian lexer agrees with Rian.Lexer over the slice-1 corpus", %{mod: mod} do
+      assert Fixpoint.check(mod, @corpus_v2, &project_v2/1) == :ok
+    end
+  end
 end
